review_scope: Read-only audit of E-CONTRACT, its receipt, the value-receiver contract, analyzer/source and retained React/DOM compiler artifacts.

method_selection_and_receiver_rules.result: matches: concrete same-package named value receivers; no pointer, interface dispatch, promotion, generic receiver, MethodExpr, or MethodVal function values

trusted_gobi_builders.result: matches exact gobi package, Node receiver, and Set/Flag/Css/Keyed/Handle whitelist; gobi/node.go declares these as value methods

role_and_schema_isolation.result: no AppIR schema or role ABI change observed; backend tags are build manifest metadata

tuple_and_call_graph.result: AppIR signatures preserve helper results State plus []gobi.Effect; Reduce calls the seven action methods; Add/Reset reach counter.Update; Initialize reaches counter.Init; role symbols remain Init/Update/View

fixture_runtime_follow_up.result: the fixed compiled fixture passed 14 retained-input Update checks, two direct locked-role guard probes, and native/direct/React/DOM/swap trace comparisons; this does not establish the opaque role-state identity policy for all compiled apps

amendment.finding: The contract's general wording 'promises the Go value-copy semantics for the supported receiver expression and method body' should explicitly identify this as source-level Go value-receiver semantics, separate from any guarantee that an external JavaScript caller's retained opaque state object is unchanged after invoking the exported role ABI. The retained executable evidence proves that object-isolation behavior for the frozen scalar/nested-struct fixture only.
amendment.recommendation: Retain the Go value-receiver profile and fixture-specific copy result; state that external ABI alias preservation/consumption is outside the general promise unless separately specified and proven. Reconcile the older compiled-frontend/CONTRACT.md statement that an Update adapter clones the argument: current pipeline code directly forwards the role call, while the conformance fixture preserves its input through its emitted method-call path. This review does not infer a Go semantic failure from forwarding alone.

limits: No tests, analyzer probes, builds, or production edits were made for this review; N5's full run was not disturbed.
The review checks author pins, inspected source, and retained artifacts; it is not a new managed-CI run.
No Manager, session ownership, cancellation, general composition, or unsupported receiver-form claim is accepted.
